desc:
Welcome to Sintonia Roleplay, a Brazilian RP game inspired by São Paulo's capital where your imagination is the limit!

👮 Become a police officer and protect the city by fighting in actions or patrolling and making stops!
🔫 Or follow the illegal path by participating in actions and escapes around the city!
💼 Prefer an honest life? Work as a doctor, mechanic, delivery driver, garbage collector, truck driver, or ride-share driver!

💰 Earn money, buy cars, houses, items, equipment, and even motorcycles to rock the SP style!

Controls:
Y - Backpack
SHIFT - Run
CTRL - ShiftLock
C - Crouch
B - Emotes
L - Lock vehicles
H - Belt
K - Mobile Phone
F8 - Commands

Everything here is fictional, including characters, settings, organizations, vehicles, and weapons. There is no intention to promote or represent specific groups; the content is intended for entertainment purposes only.

⭐ If you liked it, please like and favorite to support our project!
